name: Slav Defense
description: A solid defense against d4 that teaches strong pawn structures and simple development.

branches.title: Main Line: Support d5 With c6

moves.title: White starts d4
moves.explanation: White takes central space. d4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Slav keeps a solid pawn structure and develops the bishop before it gets trapped.

By move 8-12, you should know your early middlegame plan: safe king, active pieces, and one central break.
